EventItemActionText: The President announced a vacancy for the position of Davidson County Sheriff and provided information for individuals and Council Members to submit nominations to the Metropolitan Clerk no later than Tuesday, October 27, 2026. A special meeting of the Rules, Confirmations, and Public Elections Committee is scheduled for Tuesday, November 10, 2026 with an election to be conducted at the Council meeting on Tuesday, November 17, 2026.
EventItemTitle: Nominations

EventItemActionText: The President called for nominations, which were submitted as follows: Council Member Huffman nominated Ann Barnett; Council Member Porterfield nominated Charlie Rodriguez. The President declared the nominations closed, with an election to be conducted at the November 17, 2026 Council meeting.
